capabilities: Speak selected or highlighted note text aloud with streaming sentence-by-sentence playback
Highlight the active sentence during playback and skip between sentences
Configure voices and models from multiple TTS providers with an API key
Cache generated audio in the vault or locally and export or embed audio files
Play text from the clipboard or OS media controls on desktop and mobile
extras: Pricing information for OpenAI audio is included; supports self-hosted OpenAI-compatible TTS servers as an alternative to paid APIs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to listen to note text as spoken audio without external tools.

relations.evidence: OpenAI compatible API server that has an /v1/audio/speech endpoint. For example openedai-speech.

requires.name: : OpenAI, Google Gemini, Hume AI, ElevenLabs, Fish Audio, Azure, MiniMax, or AWS Polly; optional=true when only some features need it.
; providers like OpenAI charge per character

summary: Text-to-speech plugin that reads highlighted or selected note text aloud using voices from multiple TTS providers.
